name: Decs (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of red and blue at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Decs (a quartered blue and red shield with a church, a rose and a bunch of grapes, with a helm, a crest and red, blue and yellow mantling) above a scroll inscribed DECS.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Decs arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
